dogecoin.text: @TheCriticalDri2 Some of the remnants of the Dogecoin I've had laying around since 2013 paid my rent this month, so I can't complain too much!  Plus it's just utterly hilarious to watch serious mainstream media have to talk about a silly dog face meme coin.  Much amuse, very coin, wow.

@elonmusk Elon, will all Teslas purchased with Dogecoin implement a Doge Mode?  Displays in comic sans, options such as "Many Temperature"  "Very Range"  "Much navigation" etc.  Enquiring minds wish to know.

@BillyM2k There's a lot of madness going on, but I think the deep core of faithful shibes is still there. I care a lot less about the monetary value of Dogecoin than I do about the fact it exists, because remembering all the crazy things the Dogecoin community has done just makes me happy.

@BillyM2k Couldn't agree more.  Dogecoin to me is a bunch of fun weirdos who sent the Jamaican bobsled team to the olympics just because they could.  That's what I've always been there for, the coin is secondary.

@BillyM2k Also insulting people for selling their own Dogecoin is rather counterproductive too.  Been seeing a lot of that in the Doge community recently, and it saddens me.  We're better than that, or at least I hope we are.

@BillyM2k @moonpaw_cc @SPIShiba @RocketDogRescue This is exactly the only reason I still really care about Dogecoin and other generous cryptos, and really lifted my spirits after nearly wanting to dump it all and walk away earlier.  Good work, all. 🙂
